response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID) SELECT ID, avg_ana, avg_ana - (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM g) AS excess FROM g WHERE avg_ana > (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM g) ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall mean is the unweighted mean of per-patient average ANA values; patients whose ANA values are all NULL have a NULL average and are ignored in that mean (and excluded by the > filter).
